name: Palais de Lomé
subtitle: The former Governor's Palace, built between 1898 and 1905 on the seafront, restored and opened as an art and culture centre on 28 November 2019.

parts.text: The former Governor's Palace, built between 1898 and 1905 on the seafront, restored and opened as an art and culture centre on 28 November 2019. It stands in a park and holds exhibitions such as Togo of the Kings.
